caveat.zh: 原始证明没有给出具体的 δ；已知上界仍是 O(n^(4/3))，所以问题本身没有解决。OpenAI 的页面没有提 Lean，由外部数学家检查；报道称人类的核查和整理工作量不小；形式化后来由其他人完成。
caveat.en: The original proof gives no explicit δ, and the best known upper bound is still O(n^(4/3)), so the problem itself is not settled. OpenAI's page does not mention Lean and says external mathematicians checked it; reports say the human checking and write-up were substantial; a formalisation was later done by others.

system: GPT-5.x, Claude, Gemini, Aristotle, Aletheia and others

title.zh: 到 2026 年年中，埃尔德什问题集里有多少开放问题被 AI 解决？
title.en: By mid-2026, how many open Erdős problems has AI solved?

summary.zh: 陶哲轩维护的维基页面逐题记录 AI 在埃尔德什问题上的贡献，把由 AI 基本独自解决的问题单独列出，例如 2026 年的第 125、741、38、694 号等，以及 5 月由 OpenAI 内部模型和 Claude Mythos 先后解决的第 90 号。
summary.en: A wiki maintained by Terence Tao records AI contributions to Erdős problems problem by problem and lists those solved essentially by AI alone — for example #125, #741, #38 and #694 in 2026, and #90 solved in May by an OpenAI internal model and Claude Mythos.

caveat.zh: 该页面标注，有些结果后来发现已有文献；页面数据截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，之后不再更新。
caveat.en: The page notes some results were later found in prior literature; its data runs to 30 June 2026 and it is no longer updated.

title.zh: 颗粒堵塞理论中，为什么两个临界指数满足 a + b = 1？
title.en: In the theory of jamming, why do two critical exponents satisfy a + b = 1?

summary.zh: 这个关系早有高精度数值支持，却一直缺少解析证明。诺贝尔奖得主 Parisi 与 Zamponi 等人在与 Claude 的交互中得到并核查了证明。
summary.en: The relation had strong numerical support but no analytic proof. Nobel laureate Giorgio Parisi, Francesco Zamponi and colleagues obtained and checked a proof while working with Claude.

caveat.zh: 结论在无限维硬球的 fullRSB 理论框架内成立。
caveat.en: Holds within the infinite-dimensional hard-sphere fullRSB framework.

title.zh: Crouzeix 猜想：矩阵的函数，范数是否不超过函数在数值域上最大值的 2 倍？（悬而未决 20 多年）
title.en: Crouzeix's conjecture: is the norm of a function of a matrix at most twice the function's maximum over the numerical range? (open for 20+ years)

summary.zh: 报道称，北京协和医学院的博士后金善木（Shanmu Jin）借助 GPT-5.6 Sol 证明了该猜想；决定性的一步出现在约 16 小时的一次自主运行中。Townsend 审阅后交给 Greenbaum 和 Crouzeix，据称他们确认证明正确；八天后 Lorist 和 Schwenninger 发表了一个更短的、同样使用 GPT-5.6 探索思路的证明。
summary.en: Reports say Shanmu Jin, a postdoctoral researcher at Peking Union Medical College, proved the conjecture with GPT-5.6 Sol; the decisive step emerged in an autonomous run of about 16 hours. Townsend reviewed it and passed it to Greenbaum and Crouzeix, who reportedly confirmed it is correct; eight days later Lorist and Schwenninger posted a much shorter proof, also exploring strategies with GPT-5.6.

caveat.zh: 尚未同行评审；AI 与人的贡献比例不明；Brett Wick 提醒，提示词里要求“假设存在完整证明”有让系统接受细微漏洞的风险。
caveat.en: Not peer reviewed; the split between AI and human contribution is unclear; Brett Wick cautions that a prompt telling the system to assume a complete proof exists risks accepting a subtle gap.

title.zh: 每个无桥图是否都有一族圈，使每条边恰好被覆盖两次？（圈双覆盖猜想）
title.en: Does every bridgeless graph have a collection of cycles covering each edge exactly twice? (the cycle double cover conjecture)

summary.zh: OpenAI 在 2026 年 7 月宣布了圈双覆盖猜想的一个证明；Jim Geelen 和 Sang-il Oum 随即各自在 arXiv 上发布了对该证明的解读文章，以便更易读懂。
summary.en: In July 2026 OpenAI announced a proof of the cycle double cover conjecture; Jim Geelen and Sang-il Oum each posted expositions of it on arXiv to make it easier to follow.

caveat.zh: 我看到的两篇 arXiv 页面没有说明证明是否已被独立验证或同行评审，也没有说明 AI 与人各自的贡献；Wikipedia 的列表称模型为 GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra。
caveat.en: The two arXiv pages I read do not say whether the proof has been independently verified or peer reviewed, or how the work was split between AI and humans; Wikipedia's list names the model as GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra.

system: Codex and Claude, with Akhil Mathew

title.zh: 阶为 n 的有限局部自由群概形，是否一定被 n 消灭？（Grothendieck 的一个问题，交换情形由 Deligne 证明）
title.en: Is a finite locally free group scheme of order n always killed by n? (a question of Grothendieck; Deligne proved the commutative case)

summary.zh: Akhil Mathew 在 AI 的协助下构造了一个非交换的反例：阶为 4 的有限自由群概形，却不被 4 消灭，并在 Lean 的 Mathlib 里形式化；PR 中披露 Codex 和 Claude 协助了构造与形式化。
summary.en: Akhil Mathew, with AI assistance, gave a non-commutative counterexample, a finite free group scheme of order 4 that is not killed by 4, and formalised it in Lean's Mathlib; the PR discloses that Codex and Claude assisted with the construction and formalisation.

caveat.zh: PR 页面只写了年份；确切日期取自 Xena Project 的汇总（7 月 11 日），其中对 AI 角色的描述与 PR 不完全一致。
caveat.en: The PR gives only the year; the date comes from the Xena Project roundup (11 July), whose description of the AI's role differs somewhat from the PR.

title.zh: 多项式映射只要雅可比行列式是非零常数，就一定可逆吗？（雅可比猜想，Smale 的 18 个问题之一）
title.en: Must a polynomial map with a nonzero constant Jacobian determinant be invertible? (the Jacobian conjecture, one of Smale's 18 problems)

summary.zh: Anthropic 的数学家 Levent Alpöge 称，Claude Fable 5 找到了一个三维多项式映射：雅可比行列式为常数 −2，却把不同的点映到同一个点，于是三维以上的雅可比猜想不成立。反例短得能放进一条 X 帖子。
summary.en: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says Claude Fable 5 found a 3D polynomial map with constant Jacobian determinant −2 that sends different points to the same point, so the Jacobian conjecture fails in dimension 3 and above. The counterexample is short enough to fit in a single X post.

caveat.zh: 二维的情形仍未解决。发现过程（如何提示模型）当时没有公开。Lean 形式化在 DeepMind 的 formal-conjectures 仓库里推进，我看到时尚未确认合并；后续有人把行列式缩放为 1，使其在所有特征下成立。消息出自 Anthropic 自己的研究者。
caveat.en: The two-dimensional case remains open. How the model was prompted had not been made public at the time. A Lean formalisation is under way in DeepMind's formal-conjectures repository and I could not confirm it was merged; a rescaled determinant-1 version was later proposed so that it works in all characteristics. The announcement came from an Anthropic researcher.

title.zh: 可拆分流总能转成不可拆分流，同时让拥塞和成本都有界吗？（Dinitz–Garg–Goemans 猜想）
title.en: Can a splittable flow always be turned into an unsplittable one with both congestion and cost bounded? (the Dinitz–Garg–Goemans conjecture)

summary.zh: Dmitry Rybin 在 X 上称，GPT-5.6 Pro 用四条简短的提示给出了反例：一个小图里分数流的成本是 58，而所有满足拥塞要求的不可拆分路由成本至少为 60。
summary.en: Dmitry Rybin posted on X that GPT-5.6 Pro, after four short prompts, produced a counterexample: a small graph where the fractional flow costs 58 while every congestion-legal unsplittable routing costs at least 60.

caveat.zh: 目前没有论文；介绍这一结果的页面没有找到对该具体图的独立重建，只提到有研究者核对了算术。该页面称，这不会直接改变实际网络路由，主要是理论上的界限。
caveat.en: No paper yet; the page describing it found no independent rebuild of the exact graph, only that several researchers reportedly checked the arithmetic. It says the result would not directly change real network routing; it marks a theoretical limit.

title.zh: 在国际数学奥林匹克的全部六道题上，AI 能不能拿到满分？
title.en: Can AI score full marks on all six International Mathematical Olympiad problems?

summary.zh: 报道称，华为的 Celia 和小红书的 dots-note-3.0 在 2026 年上海 IMO 上拿到 42/42 的满分，而 2025 年谷歌和 OpenAI 的模型只达到金牌线。
summary.en: Reports say Huawei's Celia and Xiaohongshu's dots-note-3.0 scored a perfect 42/42 at IMO 2026 in Shanghai, whereas in 2025 Google's and OpenAI's models reached only the gold line.

caveat.zh: 成绩由公司发布；报道没有提到 IMO 官方评分，也没有评分方法的细节。
caveat.en: Company-announced; the report mentions no official IMO grading and gives no grading details.

title.zh: Hadamard 矩阵猜想仍未解决，但此前没人构造出的 668 阶等，能构造出来吗？
title.en: The Hadamard conjecture is open, but can orders such as 668, for which no matrix was known, be constructed?

summary.zh: Epoch AI 的开放问题页面称，Anthropic 的一位研究者报告，由三位人类与 Claude 组成的团队得到了 2000 阶以内所有此前没有已知构造的容许阶数的 Hadamard 矩阵（页面点名 668 阶）；Wikipedia 的列表给出了十二个阶数。
summary.en: Epoch AI's open-problems page says an Anthropic researcher reported that a team of three humans and Claude produced Hadamard matrices for all admissible orders up to 2000 with no previously known construction (the page names order 668); Wikipedia's list gives twelve orders.

caveat.zh: Epoch 暂时把该题标为 AI 已解决，若团队报告人类对核心数学想法有重大贡献会修改；页面没有说明验证方式；Hadamard 猜想本身仍未解决。
caveat.en: Epoch has provisionally marked the problem solved by AI and will revise it if the team reports significant human contribution to the core ideas; the page does not describe how it was verified; the Hadamard conjecture itself is still open.

system: GPT-5.6 Pro (Lech Mazur); Claude Opus 5 for the Lean formalisation

title.zh: 多项式的零点都在单位圆盘内时，每个零点附近一单位圆盘内是否一定有导数的零点？（Sendov 猜想）
title.en: If all zeros of a polynomial lie in the closed unit disk, must each zero have a zero of the derivative within distance 1? (Sendov's conjecture)

summary.zh: 据 Wikipedia 的汇总，Lech Mazur 借助 GPT-5.6 Pro 给出了对所有次数 n≥2 的证明；陶哲轩把论证梳理简化，并在 Lean 中形式化，该形式化的代码几乎全部由 Claude Opus 5 在他的指导下写出。证明同时涵盖 Phelps–Rodriguez 猜想。
summary.en: According to Wikipedia's roundup, Lech Mazur used GPT-5.6 Pro to give a proof for all degrees n ≥ 2; Terence Tao digested and simplified the argument and formalised it in Lean, with nearly all of the Lean code written by Claude Opus 5 under his direction. The proof also covers the Phelps–Rodriguez conjecture.

caveat.zh: Lean 项目页面写明“没有进行任何外部或独立评审”，也不主张新颖性（另有先前的 Lean 形式化）；用到数值证书。
caveat.en: The Lean project page states that no external or independent review has been performed and claims no novelty (an earlier Lean formalisation exists); it relies on numerical certificates.

title.zh: 给定最小距离，二进制纠错码最多能有多大？
title.en: How large can a binary error-correcting code with a given minimum distance be?

summary.zh: OpenAI 称 Astra 对任意给定最小距离的二进制码的最大规模给出了指数级改进的界，对高维球码也有类似结果。
summary.en: OpenAI says Astra gave exponentially improved bounds on the maximum size of binary codes at any prescribed minimum distance, with analogous results for high-dimensional spherical codes.

caveat.zh: 发布方主张；OpenAI 的页面未提外部专家评审，称论证在 Lean 中形式化。
caveat.en: Publisher's claim; OpenAI's page mentions no external expert review and says the arguments were formalised in Lean.

title.zh: 格上的最近向量问题，能近似到多好？（与后量子密码有关）
title.en: How well can the closest vector problem in lattices be approximated? (relevant to post-quantum cryptography)

summary.zh: OpenAI 称 Astra 证明了欧氏最近向量问题在多项式因子内近似是 NP 难的。
summary.en: OpenAI says Astra proved that approximating the Euclidean closest vector problem within a polynomial factor is NP-hard.

caveat.zh: 发布方主张；OpenAI 的页面未提外部专家评审。
caveat.en: Publisher's claim; OpenAI's page mentions no external expert review.

title.zh: 算子代数中的 Connes 刚性猜想成立吗？
title.en: Does Connes's rigidity conjecture in operator algebras hold?

summary.zh: OpenAI 称 Astra 给出了这个猜想的反例，即猜想不成立。
summary.en: OpenAI says Astra disproved the conjecture.

caveat.zh: 发布方主张；Lean 形式化已公开，同行评审尚未完成。
caveat.en: Publisher's claim; Lean formalisation is public, peer review pending.

title.zh: 重心是唯一内部格点的凸体，体积最大能是多少？（Ehrhart 体积猜想）
title.en: How large can the volume of a convex body be if its centroid is its only interior lattice point? (Ehrhart's volume conjecture)

summary.zh: OpenAI 称 Astra 在每个维度都确定了这个最大体积。
summary.en: OpenAI says Astra determined this maximum volume in every dimension.

caveat.zh: 发布方主张；OpenAI 的页面未提外部专家评审。Wikipedia 的汇总把它描述为部分证明（给出上界 (n+1)^n/n!，等号情形仍未解决），与 OpenAI 的说法不一致。
caveat.en: Publisher's claim; OpenAI's page mentions no external expert review. Wikipedia's roundup describes it as a partial proof (the upper bound (n+1)^n/n!, equality case still open), which differs from OpenAI's wording.

title.zh: 多色三角形 Ramsey 数增长多快？极值图论的紧致性与退化猜想成立吗？（埃尔德什第 183、146、180 号问题）
title.en: How fast do multicolour triangle Ramsey numbers grow, and do the compactness and degeneracy conjectures of extremal graph theory hold? (Erdős problems #183, #146, #180)

summary.zh: OpenAI 称 Astra 给出了多色三角形 Ramsey 数的超指数下界（解决埃尔德什第 183 号问题），并就极值图论的紧致性与退化猜想给出结果（解决第 146 和 180 号问题）。
summary.en: OpenAI says Astra gave a superexponential lower bound for multicolour triangle Ramsey numbers (resolving Erdős problem #183) and results on the compactness and degeneracy conjectures in extremal graph theory (resolving #146 and #180).

caveat.zh: 发布方主张；OpenAI 的页面未提外部专家评审。
caveat.en: Publisher's claim; OpenAI's page mentions no external expert review.

title.zh: 是不是每个可数群都能用有限置换来近似？（Gromov 1999 年提出的 sofic 群问题）
title.en: Can every countable group be approximated by finite permutations? (Gromov's 1999 question on sofic groups)

summary.zh: OpenAI 称 Astra 给出了第一个非 sofic 群的显式构造，从而回答了这个问题。
summary.en: OpenAI says Astra gave the first explicit construction of a non-sofic group, answering the question.

caveat.zh: 发布方主张；Lean 形式化已公开，同行评审尚未完成。
caveat.en: Publisher's claim; Lean formalisation is public, peer review pending.

title.zh: 计算矩阵的积和式（permanent），算术电路至少需要多大？
title.en: How large must arithmetic circuits computing the permanent be?

summary.zh: OpenAI 称 Astra 为用算术电路和算术公式计算积和式给出了新的下界，其中算术公式的下界为 n⁴/log n 量级。
summary.en: OpenAI says Astra proved new lower bounds for computing the permanent with arithmetic circuits and formulas, including a formula lower bound of order n⁴/log n.

caveat.zh: 发布方主张；OpenAI 的页面未提外部专家评审。
caveat.en: Publisher's claim; OpenAI's page mentions no external expert review.

title.zh: 两人量子博弈重复多次后，获胜概率能不能指数衰减？（量子并行重复）
title.en: When a two-player quantum game is repeated in parallel, does the winning probability decay exponentially? (quantum parallel repetition)

summary.zh: OpenAI 称 Astra 证明了一般两人量子博弈的指数并行重复定理。
summary.en: OpenAI says Astra proved an exponential parallel repetition theorem for general two-player quantum games.

caveat.zh: 发布方主张；OpenAI 的页面未提外部专家评审。
caveat.en: Publisher's claim; OpenAI's page mentions no external expert review.

title.zh: 高维空间里，等大小的球最多能占据多大比例的空间？（球堆积密度的上界）
title.en: In high dimensions, what fraction of space can equal spheres fill at most? (upper bounds on sphere-packing density)

summary.zh: OpenAI 称 Astra 给出了高维球堆积密度的新上界，一直推进到 Cohn–Elkies 阈值。
summary.en: OpenAI says Astra gave new upper bounds on high-dimensional sphere-packing density, down to the Cohn–Elkies threshold.

caveat.zh: 发布方主张；上界的改进不等于确定了最大密度。OpenAI 的页面未提外部专家评审。
caveat.en: Publisher's claim; an improved upper bound does not determine the maximum density. OpenAI's page mentions no external expert review.

title.zh: 黎曼猜想还没解决，但黎曼ζ函数的非平凡零点，能证明至少有多大比例落在临界线上？（黎曼猜想的部分进展）
title.en: The Riemann Hypothesis is still open, but what proportion of the zeta function's nontrivial zeros can be proved to lie on the critical line? (partial progress toward the Riemann Hypothesis)

summary.zh: Anthropic 称，Claude 的研究版本把已知下界从 41.6% 提高到 67.2%，同时公开了论文、专家意见和 Lean 形式化证明。
summary.en: Anthropic reports that a research version of Claude raised the known lower bound from 41.6% to 67.2%, releasing the paper, expert notes and a Lean formalization.

caveat.zh: 黎曼猜想本身没有被证明，这是攻关过程中顺带得到的结果。
caveat.en: The Riemann hypothesis itself remains unproven; this was a byproduct of the attempt.

title.zh: 相邻素数之差有无穷多次不超过某个常数，这个常数最小能证到多少？（孪生素数猜想的方向）
title.en: The gap between consecutive primes is at most some constant infinitely often; how small can that constant be proved to be? (toward the twin prime conjecture)

summary.zh: OpenAI 的论文《Improved Short Gaps Between Primes》称，由 GPT-6 Astra 给出证明：相邻素数之差无穷多次不超过 186，改进了此前的 246。方法基于 Zhang、Polymath 8 和 Maynard 的筛法。
summary.en: OpenAI's paper Improved Short Gaps Between Primes says GPT-6 Astra proved that consecutive primes differ by at most 186 infinitely often, improving on the earlier 246. The method builds on the sieve methods of Zhang, Polymath 8 and Maynard.

caveat.zh: 论文附有 Lean 形式化，但它以数值积分界和指数和估计为显式假设，所以并未从头完整验证；尚未得到独立核实；孪生素数猜想（间隔为 2）仍然开放。
caveat.en: The paper includes a Lean formalisation, but it takes numerical integral bounds and exponential-sum estimates as explicit assumptions, so it does not verify the result from first principles; not independently verified; the twin prime conjecture (gap 2) remains open.

title.zh: 雄性果蝇完整的中枢神经系统是怎样连接的？
title.en: How is the complete male fruit-fly nervous system wired?

summary.zh: 借助 AI 辅助的电子显微镜图像分割与重建，研究者公开了超过 16.6 万个神经元、1.25 亿个突触连接的完整图谱。
summary.en: With AI-assisted electron-microscopy segmentation and reconstruction, researchers released a map of over 166,000 neurons and 125 million synapses.

title.zh: 费马大定理的证明，能不能完整地用计算机逐步验证？
title.en: Can the proof of Fermat's Last Theorem be fully checked by computer?

summary.zh: Anthropic 称数十个 Claude 智能体用 Lean 完成了费马大定理证明的端到端形式化，写了约 1300 万行 Lean 代码。
summary.en: Anthropic reports dozens of Claude agents completed an end-to-end Lean formalization of the proof of Fermat's Last Theorem, about 13 million lines of Lean.

caveat.zh: 是对已知证明的形式化验证，不是新的数学发现；发布方自己的研究。
caveat.en: Formal verification of a known proof, not new mathematics; company research.

title.zh: 环论中的 Köthe 猜想成立吗？
title.en: Does Köthe's conjecture in ring theory hold?

summary.zh: Adamczewski、Böhmler 和 Marczinzik 的预印本构造了 Köthe 猜想的反例，并回答了 Rowen 的一个问题。Wikipedia 的汇总称，这项工作使用了 GPT-6 Astra，并附有 Lean 形式化。
summary.en: A preprint by Adamczewski, Böhmler and Marczinzik constructs a counterexample to Köthe's conjecture and answers a question of Rowen. Wikipedia's roundup says the work used GPT-6 Astra and includes a Lean formalisation.

caveat.zh: arXiv 页面本身没有提到 AI 或 Lean，这两点来自 Wikipedia 的汇总；预印本，尚无同行评审信息。
caveat.en: The arXiv page itself mentions neither AI nor Lean; those come from Wikipedia's roundup; a preprint with no peer-review information.

system: OpenAI internal model (GPT-6 Astra for Lean)

title.zh: 一开始光滑的三维流体，会不会在有限时间内出现奇点？（Navier–Stokes 千禧年难题）
title.en: Can a smooth 3D fluid develop a singularity in finite time? (the Navier–Stokes Millennium Problem)

summary.zh: OpenAI 称其内部模型证明了：在施加光滑外力的情况下，Navier–Stokes 方程的解会在有限时间内爆破，并公开了 Lean 形式化证明；同时还给出了无外力 Euler 方程的爆破结果。
summary.en: OpenAI says its internal model proved finite-time blowup for Navier–Stokes with a smooth external force, releasing a Lean formalization, plus a blowup result for the unforced Euler equations.

caveat.zh: 这是发布方的主张，尚未经同行评审，也未获克雷研究所认定。Buckmaster 与 Alpöge 同期发表了相关的爆破结果，双方存在归属争议。
caveat.en: Publisher's claim; not yet peer reviewed or recognised by the Clay Institute. Buckmaster and Alpöge posted related blowup results concurrently, with a dispute over credit.

title.zh: 线性拟阵上的“强秘书问题”猜想成立吗？
title.en: Does the strong secretary conjecture hold for linear matroids?

summary.zh: 研究者通过与 ChatGPT 对话得到了该猜想在线性拟阵情形下的证明。
summary.en: Researchers obtained a proof of the conjecture for linear matroids through a conversation with ChatGPT.

caveat.zh: 前一天另一组人类研究者用几乎相同的方法发布了同样的结果。
caveat.en: Another team posted essentially the same result with a nearly identical approach the day before.

title.zh: 在数据很少的情况下，能不能设计出一类新的杀菌聚合物？
title.en: With little data, can we design a new class of antibacterial polymers?

summary.zh: 斯坦福团队从抗菌肽数据迁移学习并结合主动学习，合成的 10 种聚合物都能抑制大肠杆菌，其中一种对生物膜特别有效。
summary.en: A Stanford team used transfer from antimicrobial-peptide data plus active learning; all 10 synthesised polymers inhibited E. coli, one especially effective against biofilms.

caveat.zh: 临床前研究。
caveat.en: Preclinical.

title.zh: 噬菌体 DNA 中一个奇怪的重复序列，背后是什么新的生物系统？
title.en: What new biological system lies behind an odd repeat pattern in phage DNA?

summary.zh: Anthropic 称约 950 个 Claude 智能体用 21 小时搜索 DNA 数据，发现了一种与逆转录酶相关的新系统，后续实验确认这些重复序列会被转录成短 RNA。
summary.en: Anthropic reports about 950 Claude agents searched DNA data for 21 hours and found a new reverse-transcriptase-associated system; lab work confirmed the repeats are transcribed into short RNAs.

caveat.zh: 生物学功能尚不清楚；发布方自己的研究。
caveat.en: Biological function unknown; company research.

title.zh: 银河系里还有多少稀有的沃尔夫-拉叶星没被发现？
title.en: How many rare Wolf–Rayet stars remain undiscovered in the Milky Way?

summary.zh: 机器学习从 Gaia 光谱中挑出 30 个候选，后续观测确认了 13 颗新的银河系沃尔夫-拉叶星。
summary.en: Machine learning picked 30 candidates from Gaia spectra; follow-up spectroscopy confirmed 13 new Milky Way Wolf–Rayet stars.

caveat.zh: AI 负责挑选候选，确认靠的是光谱观测。
caveat.en: AI chose targets; spectroscopy did the confirming.

title.zh: 高维空间里，一个球最多能同时与多少个等大的球相切？（亲吻数下界）
title.en: In high dimensions, how many equal spheres can touch a central one at once? (kissing-number lower bounds)

summary.zh: 浙江大学的 Qiushi Engine 多智能体系统自主搜索、分析和验证，把 19 个维度（25、27、32–39、43、45、49–55）的亲吻数下界刷新，例如 K(25) ≥ 197,580，K(55) ≥ 53,301,140。
summary.en: Zhejiang University's multi-agent Qiushi Engine searched, analysed and verified autonomously, improving kissing-number lower bounds in 19 dimensions (25, 27, 32–39, 43, 45, 49–55), e.g. K(25) ≥ 197,580 and K(55) ≥ 53,301,140.

caveat.zh: 预印本；作者称每个结果都有可独立检查的有限证书，我没有逐个核对。
caveat.en: A preprint; the authors say each result comes with finite, independently checkable certificates, which I have not checked one by one.

title.zh: 一个 AI 模型能同时在多少个数学问题上取得新结果？
title.en: How many mathematical problems can one AI model produce new results on at once?

summary.zh: OpenAI 公开了一批由内部模型得到的新数学结果及部分 Lean 形式化证明。发布方按 ChatGPT Pro 思考的计算用量折算，平均每个结果约相当于 3 小时，并公开了推理摘要和尝试问题数量等信息。
summary.en: OpenAI released new mathematical results from an internal model and Lean formalizations of some proofs. The publisher estimates average compute per result as equivalent to roughly three hours of ChatGPT Pro thinking, and provides reasoning summaries and attempted-problem statistics.

caveat.zh: 各结果的验证程度不同，需要逐题拆分查看。
caveat.en: Verification varies by result; each needs to be examined individually.

title.zh: 紫外巡天留下的大片空白，能不能补成一幅覆盖全天的紫外地图？
title.en: Can the gaps in ultraviolet surveys be filled to make a full-sky UV map?

summary.zh: Brice Ménard 报告，他与 Claude Science 整合、校准多组紫外巡天数据，并利用其他波段的信息估计未观测区域，生成了覆盖全天的紫外地图。地图区分观测与预测区域，并提供不确定度估计。
summary.en: Brice Ménard reports working with Claude Science to combine and calibrate UV surveys, estimate unobserved regions from other wavelengths, and produce a full-sky UV map. The map distinguishes measured and predicted regions and provides uncertainty estimates.

caveat.zh: 约三分之一天区由模型预测补全，不是新获得的紫外观测；研究者参与规划、检查和纠错。
caveat.en: About a third of the sky is filled by predictions rather than new UV observations; the researcher guided, checked and corrected the work.
